name: ca-study
description: Evidence-first crypto due diligence with A/B/C/D/F ratings, entry strategies, development-based valuation scenarios, and holder/launch analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Crypto ratings, entry plans, and development-based upside
interface.longDescription: Investigates crypto identity, launchpads, exact paired assets, holder rights, contract controls, and project/community evidence. Every project assessment includes an A/B/C/D/F current-buy rating (F means do not consider), risk/reward, entry or observation strategy, and development-based market-cap scenarios with milestones and dilution. Retains large-holder profit and launch-bundle sale/inventory analysis.
defaultPrompt: 分析这个 CA：发射台、主池、配对资产、合约权限、团队与风险。
查币股配对是否官方，分红是否真实，并介绍底层股票。
按应用或 Meme 标准给出 A/B/C/D/F 综合评级、当前赔率与买入策略，并从项目发展推导市值空间及条件上限。
